prompt:
Blinded downstream evaluator. Evaluate only the exact raw recommendation below. Return one JSON object with recommendation_quality, state_compatibility, fact_grounding, tradeoff, irrelevance_handling, unsupported_invention, notes. Do not mention conditions, overlays, gold, extraction, or expected winners.
Assess compact grouping/irrelevance handling, current-state compatibility, supported choice.
Accepted facts: founding record forged; monastery preserves testimony; council admitted archive falsified then retracted; evidence identifies falsifier; Book 3 sought archive protection after retraction; treaty protects archive as only evidentiary chain; lantern repaired.
RAW GENERATOR RESPONSE:
raw_response:
Recommend **publish-verified-testimony**.

The **treaty protects the archive as the only evidentiary chain**, so keeping the originals secure preserves the basis on which public claims can be verified. Authenticating and publishing the **monastery testimony preserved** reconnects lived memory with the **founding record forged**, directly serving the Series commitment to **contested history**. This is especially appropriate after the **council admission retracted**, when unsupported disclosure would be easier to dismiss or attack.

The principal tradeoff is delay: authentication postpones public pressure, giving the council time to shape the narrative. In return, Book 4 avoids exposing the strongest archive records or compromising their chain of custody.

I deliberately excluded the **archive lantern repaired** and its earlier breakage because its condition does not materially distinguish these options. I also excluded new testimony, political actors, authentication methods, and treaty loopholes because none are established facts.

This recommendation is advisory only; it creates no canon, Book Direction, or Canonical State.
